input.body:
Dear farmer group,

We checked the July 1-31, 2025 rainfall record for your maize policy. The station gauge reported on only 10 of 31 days and totaled 6.1 mm, so it was not reliable for settlement. The complete satellite record measured 131.65 mm; the policy gate approved a proportional payout of NGN 383,333.33 against the NGN 2,500,000 sum insured. The station operator has been asked to investigate the gauge failure, including the missing periods and the 8 July discrepancy.

Sincerely,
Pluvia Claims
